newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds closed lower after a roller-coaster ride, pushed down before the close by other European markets in a technical movement, dealers said.

"We do not expect that much this week," a dealer at a big U.S. house in Madrid said. "Actually we don't expect anything until the first quarter in 1997". The spread versus Bunds was likely to stay around recent levels, he added.
The 10-year spread over Bunds was higher this evening at 174 basis points from 170 this morning. "Any level from 150 basis points and 190 will be considered normal," he said.
But bonos are seen outperforming Italian Btps.
The 10-year spread over Italian Btps ended around 53.
"We expect it will widen in the coming days," Robert Huw, strategist at Natwest in London said.
On Tuesday the only domestic factor will be the one-year bill auction, expected to show the same yield as last time.
"It's going to be a non-event," a dealer said.
U.S. data, especially GDP on Wednesday and unemployment on Friday, will be the only market driving factor in the coming days, one dealer added.
